scenes.say: Your Java app is eating CPU. How do you figure out what's going on?

scenes.label: jstack
scenes.sub: Shows all threads and their stack traces.
scenes.say: First, grab a thread dump using jstack. This shows every thread and what it's doing right now.

scenes.title: Thread Dump & Profiling
scenes.say: Run jstack with the process ID to get a snapshot. For a deeper look, use async-profiler to visualize CPU hotspots.
Here's my process: capture a thread dump, spot threads stuck in loops or locks, then profile CPU usage to see where the time goes.

scenes.question: Is a thread dump enough for CPU issues?
scenes.right: No, profiling tools reveal hotspots and code paths
scenes.say: Don't fall for this: a thread dump alone isn't always enough. Profiling tools like async-profiler reveal the real CPU hogs.
